camel_example: aliyun cloudfw DescribeVpcFirewallCenList --region cn-hangzhou --RegionNo 'cn-hangzhou' --RouteMode auto --NetworkInstanceId 'vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000' --PageSize 10 --MemberUid 2580394279020000 --CurrentPage 1 --TransitRouterType Basic --CenId 'cen-x5jayxou71ad730000' --FirewallSwitchStatus opened --Lang zh --VpcFirewallName 'vpc-firewall-test' --VpcFirewallId 'vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000'
description_en: Retrieves the details of VPC firewalls that protect traffic between a specified VPC and network instances in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 查询VPC边界防火墙（防护云企业网内的网络实例和指定VPC之间的互访流量）的信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-firewall-cen-list --lang zh --region-no cn-hangzhou --network-instance-id vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000 --firewall-switch-status opened --vpc-firewall-id vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000 --vpc-firewall-name vpc-firewall-test --cen-id cen-x5jayxou71ad730000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --route-mode auto --member-uid 2580394279020000 --transit-router-type Basic --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpcFirewallCenList

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文。

- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC.

> For more information about the regions that Cloud Firewall supports, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.help_zh:
VPC所在的地域ID。

> 关于云防火墙支持地域的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network instance
parameters.name: network_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

- **opened**: The firewall is enabled.

- **closed**: The firewall is disabled.

- **notconfigured**: The firewall is not configured.

- **configured**: The firewall is configured but is disabled.

> If you leave this parameter empty, VPC firewalls in all states are queried
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的状态。取值：

- **opened**：已开启。

- **closed**：已关闭。

- **notconfigured**：表示暂未配置VPC边界防火墙。

- **configured**：表示已配置但未开启VPC边界防火墙。

> 不设置该参数表示查询所有状态的VPC边界防火墙
parameters.name: firewall_switch_status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC firewall
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_id

parameters.help_en: The instance name of the VPC firewall
parameters.help_zh: VPC边界防火墙的实例名称
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number to return.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。

默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置每页包含VPC边界防火墙的数量。

默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果。最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The routing mode. Valid values:

- **auto**: automatic mode.

- **manual**: manual mode.

> If you leave this parameter empty, VPC firewalls that use all routing modes are queried
parameters.help_zh:
路由模式。取值：

- **auto**：表示自动模式。

- **manual**：表示手动模式。

> 不设置该参数表示查询所有路由模式的VPC边界防火墙
parameters.name: route_mode

parameters.help_en: The UID of a member account that is managed by your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号（其他阿里云账号）UID
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en:
The type of the transit router. Valid values:

- **Basic**: Basic Edition transit router.

- **Enterprise**: Enterprise Edition transit router
parameters.help_zh:
转发实例路由器类型。可选值：

- **Basic**：基础版转发路由器。

- **Enterprise**：企业版转发路由器
parameters.name: transit_router_type
